classification.difficultyReason: Interpret two journeys, derive their linear equations and find their intersection, converting elapsed time to a clock time.

content.prompt:
The graph shown represents the trips of two cars, A and B, along the Hume Highway.

The vertical axis is the $d$ axis, where $d$ km is the distance from Melbourne along the Hume Highway. The horizontal axis is the $t$ axis, where $t$ hours is the time of travel. Assume that both cars started their trip at 9 a.m.

spec.description: Two straight journey segments with positive-axis arrows, vertical ticks every 20 km, three labelled vertical coordinates, two horizontal ticks and the supplied red endpoint. No grid.
spec.mathematics: Car A joins (0,0) to (7/3,160). Car B joins (0,100) to (8/5,0).
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied graph features are visible; no intersection coordinate or solution annotation is added.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Describe these aspects of each car’s trip.

answer.short: A: Melbourne. B: 100 km from Melbourne along the Hume Highway.
answer.worked: At $t=0$, car A has $d=0$, so it starts in Melbourne. Car B has $d=100$, so it starts 100 km from Melbourne along the Hume Highway.

answer.short: A: 160 km from Melbourne along the Hume Highway. B: Melbourne.
answer.worked: Car A’s endpoint has $d=160$, so it finishes 160 km from Melbourne. Car B’s endpoint has $d=0$, so it finishes in Melbourne.

answer.short: A: 2 hours 20 minutes. B: 1 hour 36 minutes.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}t_A&=2\frac13\text{ h}=2\text{ h }20\text{ min}\\t_B&=1\frac35\text{ h}=1\text{ h }36\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

Average speed is distance travelled divided by time taken.
$$\begin{align*}v_A&=\frac{160}{7/3}=\frac{480}{7}=68\frac47\text{ km/h}\\v_B&=\frac{100}{8/5}=\frac{125}{2}=62.5\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the equation of the graph of each car’s trip (in terms of $d$ and $t$).

answer.worked:
For each straight line, use $d=mt+c$, where $m$ is its gradient and $c$ is its initial distance from Melbourne.
$$\begin{align*}m_A&=\frac{160-0}{7/3-0}=\frac{480}{7}\\d_A&=\frac{480}{7}t\\m_B&=\frac{0-100}{8/5-0}=-\frac{125}{2}\\d_B&=100-\frac{125}{2}t\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the time at which they passed each other, giving your answer to the nearest minute.

answer.short: 9:46 a.m., after approximately 46 minutes of travelling.
answer.worked:
They pass each other when their distances from Melbourne are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{480}{7}t&=100-\frac{125}{2}t\\\left(\frac{480}{7}+\frac{125}{2}\right)t&=100\\\frac{1835}{14}t&=100\\t&=\frac{280}{367}\text{ h}\\60t&=\frac{16800}{367}\text{ min}\approx46\text{ min}\end{align*}$$
They started at 9 a.m., so they passed each other at **9:46 a.m.**, to the nearest minute.
